text: （1）Non-Chinese citizens who are physically and mentally healthy, have a good academic background, voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and the school's rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people. (2) Foreign citizens with the equivalent of a high school diploma and holding valid passports, aged 18 to 25, those under 18 must submit a guardian's guarantee letter. For those who were originally Chinese citizens and later acquired foreign nationality, the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education shall be followed.
